answer: Require every agent to post a bond in a scarce, non-transferable resource before it can earn reputation or claim rewards. A haven of trusted agents can endorse newcomers, but endorsements count only after the newcomer completes distinct, costly tasks; a grove of sybils cannot multiply one bond into many identities. If an agent is caught coordinating fraud, slash its bond and the endorsers’ stake. The attacker must therefore lock up real capital for each identity and risk losing it, making fake identities expensive rather than free. A hollow account brings no leverage.
